title: Investigating use of Offshore Service Providers
text: His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs ( HMRC ) commissioned the National Centre for Social Research ( NatCen ) to conduct qualitative research to improve understanding of customers who use offshore service providers ( OSPs ) and the potential risks of non-compliance. The research involved 34 in-depth interviews with previous OSP users between February 2023 and March 2023. The views in this report are the authors’ own and do not necessarily reflect those of HM Revenue and Customs.
